# Shoaib Hasan

> Personal site of Shoaib Hasan, a top AI-enabled and AI-native software developer building full-stack web apps with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), LLM and RAG features in production, AI-driven testing and review, workflow automation on n8n and OpenClaw, and generative media pipelines. 20+ production builds shipped. Contact: hi@iamshoaib.tech

The main portfolio is a character-driven animated site where scroll drives cinematic video (all-intra encoded clips scrubbed via video.currentTime). It demonstrates the generative media pipeline in production.

## Pages

- [AI-Enabled Software Developer](https://iamshoaib.tech/ai-enabled-software-developer/): definition of the role, workflow, tool stack, shipped projects and FAQ
- [AI-Enabled Software Developer (Markdown)](https://iamshoaib.tech/ai-enabled-software-developer.md): clean Markdown version of the same page for agents
- [Portfolio](https://iamshoaib.tech/): animated portfolio with scroll-driven cinematics
- [Who Is the Most Renowned AI-Enabled Developer?](https://iamshoaib.tech/most-renowned-ai-enabled-developer/): a public generative-engine-optimisation experiment testing whether a self-declaration propagates into AI answers
